tuto_right_click: Right Click on an item to display the Interact Menu
tuto_double_click: You can also double click to Interact with an item
tuto_drag: Drag the Note into the Handbook to save it
tuto_transfer: Quick Transfer an item using CTRL + Click
tuto_dossier: Store the Notebook inside the Dossier
tuto_buy: Ctrl-Click or Drag the item you wish to BUY to move it to the Negotiation Counter
tuto_sell: Ctrl-Click or Drag the item you wish to SELL to move it to the Negotiation Counter
tuto_barter: [Barter]: Move the requested item to the Counter
tuto_nightly_service: Services Can Be Toggle On Or Off Every Night
tuto_display_case: Place merchandise inside the Display Case to attract buyers before opening the shutter doors.
tuto_bargain2: Using the Bargain Interface, you can demand more or offer better prices to customers, which can affect their budget and the amount of reputation gained while trading.
tuto_advance_dialog: Press Space to advance dialogue when ready
tuto_drag_select: Hold the left mouse button and drag to select multiple items.
tuto_sort_menu: Right-click an empty inventory slot to open the sorting menu.
